jobs.occupation: Electronics Design Engineer (m/f/x) (Elektroniker/in - Informations- und Telekommunikationstechnik)
jobs.description:
At go-e, we have been pursuing the development of our vision with passion and strength from the very beginning. We are moving in an area that is characterized by breakthroughs and growth and that requires a lot of personal responsibility and creative solution finding. On our journey towards the energy transition, the mixture of innovation and security, regional and international, self-realization and professionalism is the ideal fuel for our mutual growth.

Our products:

-Incorporate high-speed embedded hardware as well as high power circuitry - providing a smart interconnection of power sources to electrical cars for charging purposes
-Satisfy high quality needs in terms of user friendliness and versatile application
-Provide an ecosystem for EV users making them independent from grid charges 

With your contribution, you will impact how people will charge their cars in the future. Come and join the team that is building the future of innovative charger solutions for e-mobility!

Your area of responsibility

- Transformation of high-level product ideas into hardware concepts - together with product owners, software and mechanical design engineers 
- Conception of complete devices in tight collaboration with product owners, software and mechanical design engineers 
- Development and simulation of circuit and PCB design as essential core of the devices using EDA tools
- Initial operation and verification of circuitry - with documentation of performance results
- Integration of the device in close collaboration with the software team
- Creation of test plans for PCBA and device manufacturing 
- Provision of full documentation set for PCBA manufacturing (Gerber, etc.)
- Maintenance for devices in the field (discontinued parts, etc.)

It would be great if you have

- At least 3 years of professional experience in the field
- University degree in electronic/electrical engineering or similar education (technician, dual education, etc.)
- Significant professional experience with Altium designer or another EDA tool
- Basic knowledge of digital circuit design/principles
- Experience with the design of analog circuits
- Familiarity with populating a PCB and using lab equipment 
- Empathy towards your colleagues with a collaborative mindset
- Ability to work with little oversight and independent decision-making
- Fluency in spoken and written English

It would be even better if you have

- Familiarity with the concepts of EMC and EMI
- Experience with HDI PCB Design
- Experience with cellular basebands and smartphone SoCs
- Experience with SI/PI Simulation or willingness to learn
- Experience with Keysight ADS

What we offer

- Be one of the key drivers of our core technologies
- A high degree of freedom in the execution of your projects
- Flexible working hours
- Mental well-being support
- Employee discounts on our products
- Corporate discounts on a variety of brands

About go-e
We are a fast-growing, successful company in the field of e-mobility and have developed from a start-up to an internationally recognized player. From our headquarters in Carinthia, Austria, we have already expanded to around 20 European countries. With bold ideas based on our passion for innovative e-mobility solutions, we are already establishing future technologies today.

Location: ERL S SP 11

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Program Lead for Expert Communities & Innovation Platforms, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening the technical capabilities of Grid Technologies (GT) and Product & Resource Management (PRM) at Siemens Energy. A typical day involves leading the GT Expert Program, engaging with technical experts globally, and driving innovation through structured expert engagement models. You will connect experts with strategic technology initiatives, facilitate knowledge sharing, and promote cross-functional collaboration, all while enhancing Siemens Energy’s position as an industry thought leader.

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Lead and evolve the GT Expert Program, including expert identification, nomination, and recognition processes
* Act as the primary interface to innovation and collaboration platforms, increasing participation in innovation challenges and campaigns
* Establish technical communities of practice and facilitate expert workshops and working groups
* Create and implement internal and external communication strategies to drive expert communication
* Support publication and dissemination of technical expertise, coordinating conference participation and technical representation
* Strengthen engagement of technical experts globally and promote cross-functional collaboration and knowledge exchange

What You Bring
* Relevant and applicable bachelor’s degree/diploma with a technical study background
* Longterm experience in expert roles or activities, with leadership experience
* Strong appreciation of engineering excellence and innovation ecosystems
* Proven experience in building expert networks, communities of practice, or innovation platforms
* Strong facilitation skills to mobilize experts across regions, functions, and business areas
* Fluent in English with strong communication skills and confident stakeholder engagement in global matrix organizations

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the mechanical systems department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Development Engineer (m/f/d) - Mechanical Analysis and Testing of Space Structures

We are seeking creative professionals with deep expertise in structural dynamics to tackle tasks in the mechanical analysis and testing of aerospace structures. The ideal candidate will bring initial professional experience in the mechanical design and verification of aerospace components (such as satellites, instruments, and mechanisms) and is eager to apply and further develop their academic and practical expertise.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains.

Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as the combat cloud and ground support systems of tomorrow. The way we work together is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, ranging from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. Anyone seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facility
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Structural Analysis: Support the execution of static and dynamic structural analyses for aerospace structures, ensuring result plausibility through manual verification methods.
- Performance Analysis: Conduct mechanical performance analyses for high-precision instruments and structures designed for space applications.
- Testing & Simulation: Contribute to the simulation and oversight of vibration testing for satellites and their sub-components.
- FEM Modeling: Develop mathematical structural models using Finite Element Analysis (FEA), focusing on application-oriented structural idealization and physical model validation using Hyperworks and NASTRAN.
- Verification of Joints: Perform strength verification for joining elements in accordance with VDI and ESA standards.
- Tool Development: Assist in developing internal Matlab-based tools for workflow optimization and the processing of analytical and test data.
- Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of all processes, specifically regarding mathematical models and analytical/test outcomes.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Education: Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Experience: Prior first professional experience in the design and verification of aerospace structures is highly preferred.
- Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in static/dynamic structural analysis (FEM) and manual calculation methods.
- Software Skills: Proficiency in Nastran and Hyperworks.
- Specific Knowledge: Solid understanding of space-specific requirements; experience with fiber-composite structure design and calculation is a plus.
- Soft Skills: A proactive, structured work style with the ability to work both independently and effectively within a team.
- Communication: Excellent communication skills.
- Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory, proficiency in German is an advantage.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

jobs.description:
About the LSM
The Graduate School Life Science Munich (LSM) is an international doctoral programme at one of Europe's leading research universities - Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU). The programme spans a wide range of disciplines including Biochemistry, Cell and Developmental Biology, Ecology, Genetics, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Plant Sciences, Zoology, and more. Doctoral candidates join a vibrant, diverse, and truly international research community at the LMU Biocenter in Planegg-Martinsried.

Doctoral Positions in Bioinformatics, Botany, Epigenetics, Ecology, Neuroscience, Plant Genetics, Systematic Zoology & more - Graduate School Life Science Munich (LSM), LMU Munich This year, two pathways are available:

1. Independent Research Proposals (new this year)
A number of LSM faculty members are open to receiving original research proposals in specific areas. Rather than applying to a pre-defined project, candidates develop their own original proposal inspired by the research interests of a participating faculty member. Should a proposal be of interest to the potential supervisor, they would be willing to support the candidate in identifying and applying for appropriate funding - such as a fellowship, scholarship, or third-party funding.
Participating faculty members and their research areas:

Prof. Claude Becker - Epigenetics, epigenomics, plant-microbe interactions, biosynthetic gene clusters

Prof. Alexander Keller - Biodiversity, AI and computer vision, plant-pollinator interactions, ecological genomics

Prof. Dario Leister - Regulation and improvement of photosynthesis (open to CSC candidates only)

Prof. Michael Matschiner - Phylogenetics, adaptive radiation, museum and fossil specimens

Dr. Natascha Turetzek - Arthropod evo-devo, gene duplication, sensory organ diversification, thermal stress

Avian Cerebral Organoids - Prof. David Keays, Sensory and Developmental Neuroscience

jobs.occupation: Testing Operator - Space Hardware Testing (all genders) (Werkstoffprüfer/in (mit Schwerpunkten))
jobs.description:
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES THE WHY We build pressure vessels and carbon structures for spaceflight. Before our hardware flies, it gets tested — and you keep the testing running. Without you, the test bench stands still. THE WHAT You prepare tests, help run them, and document the results. You work in the lab and at the test bench — hands-on, in a team, with real space hardware every day. Your tasks in detail:
• Prepare and post-process the testing areas: You set up test benches and specimens, tear down after tests, and keep the testing area ready for action. → High Performance: The test bench is ready when the team needs it.
• Run and document tests: You support destructive testing and acceptance testing (NDT) and record every step cleanly. → Accountability: What was tested is documented. No gaps.
• Say what you see: Anything unusual about a specimen, the test bench, or a result — you report it right away, not when someone asks. → Candor: You raise problems before they grow.
• Support the team and infrastructure: You pitch in where needed — in the testing team and with technical infrastructure on site. → Togetherness: We win as a team.
• Learn new things: NDT methods, new test procedures, new materials — you want to grow. We'll train you. → Playfulness: Curiosity is a strength here, not a distraction.

YOUR PROFILE
• Training: Completed vocational training as a materials tester / Werkstoffprüfer (plastics, metals, or fiber composites/CFRP) or comparable technical training.
• Experience: First experience in a test lab or materials testing is a plus — not a must. What matters more: you want to learn.
• Work style: Motivated, reliable, hands-on. You want the job done — and done right.
• Team player: You enjoy working with others and help out when things get busy.
• Languages: German and English, each at B2 minimum — one of the two confident for daily work.
• On-site: This role is 100% on-site in Taufkirchen. The lab and test bench don't fit in a home office.

#LI-Onsite

WHAT WE OFFER
• Creative freedom & responsibility: Autonomy, scope for decision-making and short implementation paths.
• Flexible working hours & remote option: You can work remotely by arrangement.
• Culinary variety: Lunch together with fresh, varied dishes every day.
• Attractive additional benefits: Choose between Deutschlandticket, EGYM-Well pass or a monthly top-up payment card (GivveCard).
• Knowledge exchange at the highest level: Work with experienced engineers and experts from the aerospace industry.
• Dynamic environment: Exciting projects, development opportunities and a start-up atmosphere with agile, cross-functional collaboration.
• Community & team spirit: Monthly blackout events for socialising, networking and exchange.
• Unique working atmosphere : Enjoy the end of the working day on our large roof terrace with a view of the Alps!

About us Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.
